bridge_explain:
For people who use scheduled actions in the Gemini app.

1. Turn it on and sign in with Google. Twice a day ForgeQuest writes your training summary to a "ForgeQuest data" Doc in your Drive.
2. Tap Copy prompt and paste it into a new scheduled action in the Gemini app.
3. Gemini writes its advice to "ForgeQuest from Gemini", and it shows on Home.

The app only sees those two Docs.

tour_1_b: ForgeQuest keeps you coming back by pacing you: it pushes on good days and backs off on tired ones.
tour_2_b: Your streak counts weeks you hit your workout target, not every single day. Rest days never break it.
tour_3_b: Start from a ready plan, or let Gemini turn a YouTube programme into one (Workouts → Change plan). Log sets with a rest timer, and new records are spotted for you.
tour_4_b: Snap a photo of your meal and AI estimates protein and calories, carbs too if you want them. The rings on Home fill as you eat.
tour_5_b: Chat any time. It remembers your injuries and equipment, writes a weekly check-in, and can rebuild your plan.
tour_6_b: Optional: connect a Fitbit through Health Connect for daily recovery, sleep and strain, and know when to push or ease off.
tour_7_b: Earn XP, climb ranks, unlock badges, and watch your progress and muscle recovery over time.
